answer: Reverse-reachability scoring resists sybils: an identity's weight is how many HONEST-SEED nodes can reach it along short trust paths, not how many nodes IT points to — so outbound edge-spam earns nothing. A fake building a bridge of thousands of outbound vouches gains zero if no seed can reach it back across the summit; the copper thread must run FROM the honest core TO the identity. A sybil cluster with no genuine inbound reachability from seeds scores near zero however many edges it emits.
